title: 第17章 只要做好详细的计划！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
什么狗屁正大光明的宗门。

    哪家正道领袖住的地方全他妈是骸骨？

    甚至血腥味都还没散去！

    宁芊芊只觉又被骗了！这群修仙的没一个是好人！说的话全是假的！

    完啦！要被邪修拿去练功啦！

    楚星尘此刻也没心思惦记身旁姑娘惨白的脸色，因为此刻他也有些生气。

    出去的时候还青山绿水，空气清净，一回家跟魔窟一样。

    破庙门口，楚星尘将沉默不语的宁芊芊放下后，大声喝道：

    “你们两个小兔崽子在做什么？”

    破庙内，李应灵率先从破庙里冲了出来，一脸激动的神色就朝自家师父拥抱了过来。

    “师父你可算回来了！”

    还没等楚星尘质问，厉行天满身血迹，双眸通红，似乎带着无边杀意，手中提溜着个老虎脑袋迈步也从破庙内走出。

    他见到楚星尘的第一句话也是一样的，只不过似乎有些悲叹意味：

    “师父你可算回来了。”

    推开怀中的李应灵，楚星尘指向一旁动物头颅造成的景观，质问道：

    “这是怎么回事？”

    李应灵目光扫过，自是明白师父生气什么，随即率先开口甩锅道：

    “这都是师弟修炼造成的！”

    站在一旁瑟瑟发抖，还怀揣着一丝希望的宁芊芊听见这话随即就死了心。

    虽然不懂修仙界，但是那个名门正派也不该会有这么血腥的修炼方式吧？

    宁芊芊扭头看向那个头颅景观，此刻她就觉得下一刻自己的脑袋或许也就挂在上面了。

    楚星尘此刻的目光转向提溜虎头脑袋的厉行天，眼神中带着严厉的质问。

    面对师父的眼神质问，厉行天默默将目光看向自家师姐，对于师姐的推锅也是欲言又止。

    动物大部分都是师姐抓的，而且造成现在这个情况，理论上师姐的责任更大一些。

    毕竟最开始厉行天还是打算找个离远一点的地方，挖个坑把这些骸骨埋了的。

    这看上去确实也有些骇人，而且味道很差劲。
content_en:
What a bullshit upright sect.

Which righteous leader lives in a place full of fucking skeletons?

Even the smell of blood hasn’t dissipated yet!

Ning Qianqian felt that she had been cheated again!None of these cultivators are good people!Everything you said is false!

It’s over!I'm going to be used by evil cultivators to practice martial arts!

Chu Xingchen didn't care about the pale face of the girl next to him at the moment, because he was also a little angry at the moment.

When we went out, the mountains and rivers were green and the air was clean. When we returned home, it was like a devil's cave.

At the entrance of the ruined temple, Chu Xingchen put down the silent Ning Qianqian and shouted loudly:

"What are you two little brats doing?"

In the dilapidated temple, Li Yingling rushed out of the dilapidated temple first and hugged his master with an excited look on his face.

"Master, you are finally back!"

Before Chu Xingchen could question him, Li Xingtian was covered in blood, his eyes were red, and he seemed to have boundless killing intent. He walked out of the ruined temple with a tiger head in his hand.

His first words when he saw Chu Xingchen were the same, but they seemed to be a bit sad:

"Master, you are finally back."

Pushing Li Yingling away from his arms, Chu Xingchen pointed to the landscape made of animal heads and asked:

"What's going on?"

Li Yingling glanced around and understood why the master was angry, so he took the lead and said:

"This is all caused by junior brother's practice!"

Ning Qianqian, who was standing aside shivering and still holding on to a glimmer of hope, gave up immediately after hearing these words.

Although he doesn't understand the world of cultivating immortals, that famous and decent sect shouldn't have such a bloody cultivation method, right?

Ning Qianqian turned to look at the skull landscape. At this moment, she felt that her head might be hanging on it next moment.

At this moment, Chu Xingchen's eyes turned to Li Xingtian, who was holding up the tiger's head, with stern questioning in his eyes.

Facing the master's questioning eyes, Li Xingtian silently looked at his senior sister, but he hesitated to say anything about her senior sister's blame.

Most of the animals were caught by the senior sister, and the current situation was caused by the senior sister. In theory, the senior sister has a greater responsibility.

After all, Li Xingtian originally planned to find a place farther away and dig a hole to bury the bones.

It does look a little scary and tastes terrible.
